Avatars.doc:
One account's avatars, keyed by device (see `caller`). The slot belongs to
the account, and so does the map nested in it: every node refuses another
account's write to either, so nobody can move, rename or evict someone
else's avatar, or squat a device id before its owner first joins.

fields.name: devices
fields.doc: Device identity (64 hex) -> that device's player row.

BlockOverride.doc: A stored block edit: block id `b` and the stamp that orders concurrent edits.

fields.name: b
fields.doc: Block id, 0 to 15; 0 is air (a broken block).

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.doc: Room-clock unix seconds; the larger stamp wins when two players edit one block.

MeroBlocks.doc: One world: its fixed metadata, every block edit and every account's players.

fields.name: meta
fields.doc:
name + seed + day-clock anchor. Every client derives the terrain from
the seed, so changing it after creation would rebuild the world under
everyone's edits: frozen, nobody (the creator included) can.

fields.name: overrides
fields.doc:
"x,y,z" -> override. Set-only (break = b:0), never removed. Public on
purpose: the world is collaborative.

fields.name: players
fields.doc: Each account's avatars, writable only by that account.

Player.doc: A player row: presence and last known transform, keyed by the player's device identity.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Position in blocks; y is up.

fields.name: sel
fields.doc: Selected hotbar slot, 0 to 8; peers render what the player holds.

fields.name: left
fields.doc: Whether the player has left; set by `leave`, cleared by `join` or `heartbeat`.

WorldMeta.doc: The world's identity: name, terrain seed and creation time. Fixed at creation.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Terrain seed; clients generate identical terrain from it.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.doc: Unix seconds; the 600 s day/night cycle is counted from here.
